input.quote: (ii) the Service will perform in all material respects to industry standards;
input.rationale: Kubient gives express performance, error-free, no-malicious-code, compliance-with-law and non-infringement warranties that run throughout the Term (better than the 90-day preferred period), and the Section 13 disclaimer is expressly subject to "the representations and warranties set forth in this Agreement", so it does not swallow them. We note the absence of an express re-perform/repair/refund remedy sentence as a sub-element to raise in negotiation rather than a fallback failure, since warranty breach is separately indemnified and a termination trigger.
